final_message: I cleaned the data by deduplicating order events based on the order id, keeping only the first occurrence and counting how many duplicates were removed. I normalized the category names by stripping spaces and converting to lowercase. I counted orders with missing totals (total = -1 or equivalent) and excluded them from revenue calculations. I parsed the placed_at timestamps to UTC and identified orders placed in March 2024 UTC to sum their totals and count them. I also aggregated total revenue by category to find the top category by revenue. The results are saved in workspace/answer.json following the Acme reporting conventions.
